name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a Mountain that lets Ragavan or Galvanic Discharge be cast, or Arena of Glory or Dalkovan Encampment once its own free condition is already met. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic first (never a scarce fetch target), then an untapped conditional land (Arena of Glory, Dalkovan Encampment) - the 'enters tapped unless you control' tier needs ties any because both can be untapped and unlocking at once (a Mountain up lets Arena add a second red and Dalkovan add white). Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this.
